facts.fact: The Ebolowa workshop of 3-14 November 2025 gave technical validation to the draft e-Gov bill on public information access and administrative digital transformation, which aims to standardise digital practice, with experts' recommendations covering interoperability; the text was then ready for ministerial finalisation (article published 2026-01-21).

note: The e-Gov bill is the only framework-like instrument; the document states no adoption and no compulsion.
